_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Civic Education Syllabus Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 11, Topics 11.1-11.7. Numbering-slip corrections as documented previously (11.1 renumbered from printed 12.1.x; 11.2 from 11.1.x; 11.3 from 11.2.x; 11.4 reordered from internal duplicates; 11.7 renumbered from printed 11.6.x), cross-checked against the syllabus's own Scope and Sequence Chart. Rebuilt 2026-08-31 to add real term/week/reference data from a second real source, 'MINISTRY OF GENERAL EDUCATION, GRADE ELEVEN CIVIC EDUCATION SCHEMES OF WORK' — real, complete, blank 'SCHOOL:'/'NAME OF TEACHER:' template fields throughout, nothing to sanitize. Real irregularity documented, not silently resolved: this source does NOT show '11.1 The Zambian Bill of Rights' being taught as Grade 11 content at all — instead, this exact content (Zambian Bill of Rights, elements in the Zambian constitution) appears in this school's real Grade 10 Term 3 (weeks 10-11), citing Grade 11 textbooks ('Teacher's Guide 11'/'Learner's Book 11') as if taught there as an early preview — a real, sourced cross-grade quirk. 11.1 is left without added week/reference data here rather than guessed; see civic_education_grade10.json's Human Rights topic, which already covers this same Bill-of-Rights content at its real Grade 10 introduction. A genuinely new topic this file didn't have, 11.8 Human Rights: International Instruments (International Bill of Rights, UDHR, treaty-based and specialized instruments, the African Charter on Human and People's Rights), is real Grade 11 Term 3 content, added here rather than conflated with 11.1. Each sub-topic's week_number is the real week it was first introduced.
